pt.name: Power Thesaurus
pt.summary: INP: 100% Good on desktop · +210% 5★ ratings · 1+ GB memory leak fixed
pt.stackShort: React · TypeScript · SSR · React Native · GraphQL
pt.description:
Power Thesaurus is a crowdsourced online English thesaurus — an international product with ~3.1 million unique monthly users. Monetized through a PRO subscription and ads.

The platform spans a server-rendered web app, iOS and Android apps built with React Native, and a browser extension for all major browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and Opera.

results.label: Good URLs in Core Web Vitals on desktop
earlier start for the main JS

pt.role: 2 years of product development in React and TypeScript across web, mobile and the extension. Focus: frontend performance and quality. I own tasks end to end — from metric analysis and breakdown to staged rollout and measuring the impact.
done: Core Web Vitals / INP. Set up field metrics with attribution of slow interactions; optimized ad refresh, autocomplete, navigation (startTransition) and Sentry init. Search Console result: 100% Good URLs on desktop, −80% poor URLs on mobile.
Loading and bundle. Code splitting and lazy loading, main-bundle preload (execution starts ~200 ms earlier), font subsetting, SVG 97 → 54 KB gzip, content-visibility.
Memory. Heap profiling revealed a leak in the ad-slot and iframe lifecycle — the tab no longer grows to 1+ GB. Wrote a technical report for the ad partner.
Testing. Covered critical flows (auth, pagination, filters, Paddle payments), replaced Cucumber/WebdriverIO with Playwright — a major dependency upgrade shipped with zero production regressions.

Stability and accessibility. Cut thousands of irrelevant events from Sentry, built resilient handling of network errors and offline mode. Keyboard navigation, ARIA, a high-contrast palette — Lighthouse Accessibility 100.
React Native. Rating prompt that picks a “safe” moment to ask — +210% 5★ ratings in 6 months. Push notifications (FCM) — +17% resubscription conversion.
Browser extension. Works across all tabs and iframes without a reload, text insertion into Gmail, Google Docs and Office Online, e2e tests on 20+ sites, passed Mozilla review.
AI, SEO, design system. Integrated AI Suggest / PRO AI, technical SEO (Schema.org, llms.txt, Private Prefetch Proxy), grew the in-house UI library.
pt.stack: React, TypeScript, SSR (Webpack, loadable-components), GraphQL (Apollo Client), React Native (Expo), Zustand, WebExtensions, Jest, Playwright, Sentry, Grafana
